subject: Zephyr SIG: evidence staging, sample logs, and scheduling
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@zephyr.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@zephyr.ai, Tim Li <tim.li@zephyr.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake + sample logs request

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for agreeing to field our SIG intake. We’re starting the evidence collection for Zephyr’s evaluation of Redwood and wanted to schedule a short intake call (30–45 min) to:

- walk through the SIG/CAIQ question set you received
- confirm owners for system diagrams and logging samples
- agree on a window for log sample extracts and redaction expectations

High-level asks up front to help us prepare:
1) Can you share your architecture diagram and a short list of components that touch customer data?
2) We typically request 7 days of sample logs (anonymized) and a sampling of audit logs. Is that feasible?
3) Preferred time slots next week (PDT) — we have availability Tue/Wed mornings.

Attaching our SIG intake checklist (zephyr_sig_request.pdf) — please confirm who from Redwood will be on the call and who will be the evidence owners.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Security Program Manager
Zephyr AI

Attachment: zephyr_sig_request.pdf (application/pdf, 142 KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@zephyr.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake + sample logs request

Hi Alyssa —

Appreciate the checklist. I can take the intake call and would like Marissa (CS lead) on for evidence coordination. Kimberly (infra/security) will handle logging detail and extraction.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue Apr 6, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Apr 7, 09:00–09:45
- Wed Apr 7, 11:00–11:45

Quick answers to your asks:
- We’ll attach a high-level network/infra diagram and a component list after the call.
- 7 days of sample logs is generally fine; we’ll need to agree on redaction rules for PII and keep sampling reproducible.
- Evidence owners:
  - Architecture + infra diagram: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.com)
  - Audit logs / retention policy: Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwood.com)
  - SIG questionnaire coordination + artifacts handoff: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)

I’ve tentatively booked Wed Apr 7, 09:00–09:45 PDT — please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@zephyr.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake + sample logs request

Thanks Marcus — confirming Wed Apr 7, 09:00 PDT works for our team. Agenda I’ll add to the invite:

1) Quick intros (5 min)
2) Walk through SIG scope and key questions (10 min)
3) Evidence mapping and owners (10 min)
4) Logistics for log sample transfer and timeline (10 min)
5) Action items and deadlines (5 min)

Notes / clarifications for Alyssa:
- For the log sample we normally provide:
  * 7 calendar days of anonymized request / inference logs (token-level payloads redacted),
  * 2–3 days of control-plane audit logs (user actions, config changes),
  * a small extract of orchestration events to show autoscaling and routing decisions.
- We prefer SFTP or a secure Drive link for evidence transfer; we will encrypt artifacts at rest and can share decryption instructions.
- Kimberly: can you confirm the retention windows and who will run the extract?

Attachment: redwood-evidence-guidance.pdf (application/pdf, 198 KB)

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@zephyr.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake + sample logs request

On Wed, Apr 7, 2027 at 09:50 AM PDT, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks — great call just now, appreciate the clarity.
> 
> Forwarding the agreed action list and artifacts.

Hi team — follow-up from the intake call and the actions I’m taking for evidence: 

Summary (short):
- We confirmed scope: SIG v2026/CAIQ-lite mapping; Zephyr requested 7 days of request/response logs + 3 days of audit logs.
- Transfer method: secure Drive link with envelope encryption (we’ll provide passphrase via separate channel).
- Redaction: token-level payloads and user identifiers will be hashed/anonymized before transfer.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Kimberly: prepare audit log extract (3 days), include schema, ETA Apr 12 EOD. Attachment: network-architecture-diagram.png (PNG, 520 KB).
- Marcus: export component list and single-page infra diagram for SIG questionnaire, ETA Apr 9 COB.
- Marissa: create HubSpot ticket and upload initial artifacts; coordinate DocuSign/PO if needed, ETA Apr 8. Link: https://hubspot.example/contacts/zephyr-12345
- Alyssa / Zephyr: confirm any specific fields you need redacted beyond PII (e.g., tenant ids).

Attachments to expect in the drop:
- network-architecture-diagram.png
- redwood-evidence-guidance.pdf
- redwood-sample-logs.tar.gz (will be uploaded to secure Drive)

If there are privacy approvals or an NDA required for the log extract, please flag now — otherwise we’ll proceed on the expected timeline.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: network-architecture-diagram.png (image/png, 520 KB)
